in_hebrew.name: רוזנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Rosanne is derived from the Hebrew word 'rosh', which means 'head' or 'rose'. The suffix 'anne' is a common Hebrew feminine suffix, which means 'grace', 'favour', or 'gift'. So, the name Rosanne can be translated as 'graceful rose', 'favoured rose', or 'gift of the rose'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to this name, but it is similar to the Hebrew name 'Rosha', which is mentioned in the Old Testament (Joshua 19:14, 21).

in_greek.name: ῥόζαννη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Rosanne is derived from the Greek word 'rhodon', which means 'rose'. The suffix 'anne' is a common Greek feminine suffix, which means 'grace' or 'mercy'. So, the name Rosanne can be translated as 'graceful rose', 'merciful rose', or 'gift of the rose'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to this name, but the name Rose (ῥόδος) is mentioned several times in the New Testament, symbolizing Christ and His love (Song of Solomon 2:1; John 12:1-2).

in_latin.name: Rosanna
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Rosanne is derived from the Latin word 'rosa', which means 'rose'. The suffix 'anna' is a common Latin feminine suffix, which means 'grace'. So, the name Rosanne can be translated as 'graceful rose', 'gift of the rose', or 'merciful rose'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to this name, but the name Rosa is mentioned in the Vulgate translation of the Bible, which was the authoritative Latin version during the Middle Ages (Song of Solomon 2:1).

in_english.name: Rosanne
in_english.long_meaning: The English name Rosanne is derived from the Old English word 'ros', which means 'rose'. The suffix 'anne' is a common English feminine suffix, which means 'grace' or 'favour'. So, the name Rosanne can be translated as 'graceful rose', 'favoured rose', or 'gift of the rose'. In the Bible, there is no direct reference to this name, but the name Rose is mentioned several times in English translations of the Bible, symbolizing Christ and His love (Song of Solomon 2:1; Isaiah 35:1).

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Rosanne' has an endearing connotation of beauty and elegance due to its connection with the rosy hue and the enchanting flower, the rose. With its association to the classic name 'Rose', 'Rosanne' became popular in English-speaking countries as a feminine given name. It was notably used in movies, literature, and music, including the character 'Rosanne Connor' from the successful television show 'Rosanne'. This cultural impact highlights the noble values of femininity, charm, and natural beauty.
data.spiritual_significance: 'Rosanne' contains an abundance of spiritual manifestations due to its literality as rosy or beautiful rose. In Christianity, roses symbolize the passion, sacrifice, and resurrection of Jesus Christ. Each petal represents a characteristic of His many virtues, such as love, hope, compassion, and purity. Likewise, 'Rosanne' evokes these qualities, reflecting the divine image of God inherent in women. Additionally, the name can be a reminder that Jesus nurtures us and grants spiritual growth just as a rose blooms under the sun. By bearing this evocative name, women following the Christian faith may carry the blessings of this spiritual significance throughout their lives.
